name: Carnival Corporation & plc
legalName: Carnival Corporation (NYSE: CCL) and Carnival plc (LSE/NYSE: CCL, via ADS) operating as a single dual-listed company
exchange: NYSE (Carnival Corporation); Carnival plc also historically listed on London Stock Exchange with ADSs on NYSE
description: Carnival Corporation & plc is the world's largest cruise operator by passenger capacity and revenue, operating a nine-brand portfolio spanning mass-market (Carnival Cruise Line, AIDA, Costa), premium (Princess, Holland America Line, P&O Cruises UK) and luxury (Cunard, Seabourn) tiers. It generates revenue from passenger ticket sales (cabin fares) and onboard/other spending (dining, beverage, casino, shore excursions, and increasingly its own private destinations such as Celebration Key and RelaxAway). Uniquely among major cruise operators, Carnival is structured as a dual-listed company combining Carnival Corporation (Panama-incorporated, Miami-headquartered, NYSE-listed) and Carnival plc (UK-incorporated, Southampton-headquartered) under one management team and board. The company reports results across two geographic ticket/onboard segments (North America and Australia; Europe) plus Cruise Support (shared services, port operations, and other costs supporting global operations) and Tour and Other (primarily Holland America Princess Alaska tour and land operations).

employees.note: ~101,000 shipboard (excluding those on leave) and ~16,000 shoreside (13,000 full-time, 3,000 part-time/seasonal)
